head: 6ecff3401. The working tree is clean for apps/codemart and flavors/codemart. The G1 edits are in the user's auto-commits 4ddb4be8e, 2f31f9cd3 and 0b6f362e3, so the G1-only diff was read as 8f95a2a24..HEAD. 74e7770..8f95a2a24 holds codemart-1..7 and other tasks, which were reviewed earlier.
notes: All five items hold under an attempted refutation. d9-03 is done except the THEME_IDS part, which is correctly deferred: shell/shellTypes.ts:17 exports only the ThemeId type, and no shared list exists (ShellProvider.tsx:71 compares literals). Nothing blocks. The non-blocking notes are follow-ups for later passes.

evidence: The verify grep ['"`]/codemart over apps/codemart *.ts/*.tsx, excluding cmPublicRoutes.ts and cmPages.tsx, finds 0 hits (exit 1). That includes bare '/codemart'. The remaining 'codemart' text is only the APK file path (cmAppDownloads.ts:3), the App Store URL (:4) and comments.

cmPublicRoutes.ts:21-50 extends CM_PROTECTED_ROUTE (tasks, reviews, architect, notifications) and adds CM_ADMIN_ROUTE with the 12 console routes and CM_TASK_QUERY_PARAM. The helpers cmRouteWithQuery (:57), cmWorkspacePath (:67), cmProjectPath, cmTaskPath (:76) and cmAdminUserPath are new. No local ADMIN_BASE, ADMIN_HOME, ADMIN_*_PATH or TASK_QUERY_PARAM is left (grep exit 1).

Replacements read hunk by hunk. CmAdminLayout: 12 nav rows, the back link, 2 brand links and the dashboard link. CmDashboardPage: STEP_ROUTES, 8 SHORTCUTS, 7 METRICS, 3 preview rows, 3 allRoute props, notification links, empty state and primary actions. CmProjectsPage :75/:114/:122/:134/:205/:283. cmAuthSession.ts:48 uses CM_ADMIN_ROUTE.home. Also CmAdminShared, CmAdminPages (queues/totals/status chips), CmAdminFinancePages:49, CmAdminUserDetailPage (users, actor activity, KYC link), cmNotificationFormat:25-34, and the extra in-scope files CmApp, CmLayout, CmProjectFundPanel, CmMarketplacePage, CmProjectDetailPage, CmTasksPage, CmVerificationPage and CmSettingsPage.

Behavior is kept. URLSearchParams keeps the old key order. It encodes values that were encodeURIComponent before, and useSearchParams decodes both. cmTaskPath keeps the old 'id ? ?task=id : list' rule. cmRouteWithQuery drops only null/undefined/'' and keeps 0.

Dead code: CmApi.ts no longer has getAnalysis, createPayment or estimate, and the unused CmAiAnalysis/CmEstimateInput/CmEstimateResult imports are gone. A grep over the whole UI package (node_modules and dist excluded) finds no caller. CmEstimatePage.tsx:67 calls cmPublicApi.estimate, and CmPayment is still used by getPayments (:267).

File split: pages/CmArchitectPage.tsx (204 lines, new, LF) matches the block removed from CmReviewsPage (constants, CmArchitectProjectList, the page) line for line. The only changes are the two route literals, now CM_PROTECTED_ROUTE.wallet and cmProjectPath. It has a default export, and cmPages.tsx:24 lazy-loads './pages/CmArchitectPage'. CmReviewsPage dropped the imports it no longer uses (useEffect, Link, 5 icons, architect types, APIResponse, cmFormatNumber). CmArchitectPage has no other importer.
Deferred: CmSettingsPage.tsx:10 THEME_IDS is unchanged. The SHELL_THEME_IDS request to pycore-ui (B2 writer) is in cross_scope; the codemart lead routes it.
A grep of zh.ts for 该交付 / 押金 / 审核员 / 您 finds 0/0/0/0.

zh.ts:2006-2008: submission_invalid_state is '此交付物当前不处于待评审状态。', review_duplicate is '你已评审过此交付物。', and review_conflict_of_interest is '不能评审自己提交的交付物。'. :1992 submission_not_found is '未找到交付物。'. This matches the PAGE_POLISH §3 glossary (submission 交付物, reviewer 评审员, deposit 保证金).

The 14 uses of 您 are now 你, in phoneUnavailable, 3 errors, returnNotice, registrationCodeHint, termsNotice, alreadySignedIn, forgot.lead, reset.lead, the 3 access.unavailable strings and denied.hint. The recorded choice, states.submission.pending_review from 待审核 to 待评审, matches the review-queue copy. Accepted.
The zh.ts dictionary is typed CmTranslationDict, and tsc passes, so en/zh key parity holds.

cmdesign-13.claimed: done (code part; Capacitor build deferred to the user)
evidence: cmFlavor.ts (new, LF) reads FLAVOR_REGISTRY['codemart'].version and flavorAssetUrl(flavor, 'icon') from the shared shell/flavor.ts, read-only, so B2 reuse and no copy. shell/flavor.ts:47-55 eager-globs flavors/*/flavor.json and the flavor assets with ?url.

cmAppDownloads.ts has no version literal (grep for \d+.\d+.\d+: 0). Both entries use CM_APP_VERSION, and the Android URL is built from it (:3). PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS and HTML_CONTENT_TYPE moved to the top of the file, as AGENTS.md asks.

CmBrand.tsx has no Braces import (grep 0). It renders the flavor icon.svg in an aria-hidden span with alt='' at 40 or 32 px. MARK_SIZE constants are at the top. CRLF is kept (index and worktree both crlf, as at base). The .cm-brand__mark CSS drops the box, because icon.svg already has its own rounded tile (rect rx=112).
flavors/codemart/flavor.json is unchanged (diff empty) and still declares version 1.0.0 as the single source. The Capacitor build and artifact are deferred to the user, as the item allows.
The ledger codes come from laravel-codemart-D7-fix, which is approved.

A scratchpad parity check re-run: CodeMartV1Gvar/CodeMartV1Constants.php:262-274 has 13 LEDGER_* values. They equal the wallet.ledger keys in en.ts:817-831 and zh.ts:819-833 (13/13/13, symmetric difference empty).

Every locale placeholder matches the server call-site params. payment_sent/received use payment_id+user_id (PaymentCtl:133-136). project_funding and escrow_remainder_refund use project_id (EscrowService:71/:227). task_escrow_release uses task_id (:305). refund_debit/credit use payment_id (FinanceService:138/:148). deposit_refunded uses deposit_id (AdminFinanceService:379). withdrawal_requested/rejected/paid use withdrawal_id (PaymentCtl:442, AdminFinanceService:481/:514). wallet_top_up and opening_balance have none.

CmWalletPage.tsx:591-595 describe() returns the stored description only when description_code is falsy. Otherwise it returns t('wallet.ledger.<code>', {...params, defaultValue: cmHumanize(code)}). The prefix constant LEDGER_KEY_PREFIX is at the top (:44). CmApiTypes.ts:405-412 types description_code?: string|null and description_params?: Record<string,string|number>|null.

In-process contract check through artisan tinker (scratchpad g1_ledger_probe.php, read-only): WalletTransactionModel::toArray() carries the description_code and description_params keys. The server description accessor (WalletTransactionModel.php:42-52) returns the stored text for rows without a code, matching the UI fallback. All 24 local rows have a null code (seeded before D7), so they take the legacy path.

assets/cmImageRegistry.ts (new, LF) is the only module with '.webp': grep -rln '\.webp' over apps/codemart *.ts/*.tsx lists only that file. The 16 CM_IMAGE_SPECS entries each have width, height, altKey and lazy. PIL confirms every width x height equals the real file (16/16 OK), and no spec lacks a file.

The icon slot is ICON_MODULES glob ./icons/*.webp (:2), CM_ICON_SPECS (:41, empty, typed) and cmIcon() (:57). There are no writes to assets/icons/ or generate_cm_images.py: the G1-window changes to those paths are the lead's codemart-lead-G1 work, which is already reviewed.

components/CmImage.tsx renders src, width, height, the localized alt (empty when decorative), loading from the registry unless eager is given, and decoding=async. CmPublicIllustration wraps it (CmPublicBlocks.tsx:15-17). CmStateViews, CmAuthLayout and CmAdminPages use it, so the direct imports and the size constants BANNER_* and AUTH_IMAGE_* are gone.

Loading and alt behavior are unchanged at each call site. Hero, process-overview, estimate and contact-support were eager and are eager (registry lazy:false). The about split still passes eager, and the services split keeps eager={index===0}. Home service cards, showcase-empty, download-devices and empty-workspace were lazy and stay lazy. Admin and auth used the browser default and are now loading=eager. The alt keys moved into the registry with the same keys, and the decorative images stay decorative.

cmPublicImages.ts and cmWorkspaceImages.ts are deleted, and a grep finds no importer left in the UI package. They were superseded source modules inside the member's own scope, and git history keeps them, so this is not a destructive action (the codemart-5 precedent).

non_blocking: New one-line JSDoc comments: cmPublicRoutes.ts:56,66,75; cmImageRegistry.ts:10,12,20,40,51,56; CmImage.tsx:8,12; cmFlavor.ts:6,9; CmApiTypes.ts:408,410; CmPublicBlocks.tsx:14. They follow the files' existing one-line style, but AGENTS.md prefers code as documentation. Drop them when these lines are next edited (same ruling as ui-vortex-D7).

Workspace routes are declared twice: CM_PROTECTED_ROUTE (cmPublicRoutes.ts:21-33, e.g. tasks '/codemart/tasks' at :28) and the CM_PAGES path (cmPages.tsx:48 'tasks'). CM_ROUTE_BASE (cmPublicRoutes.ts:1) also repeats flavor.json rootRoute. Later: derive one from the other, e.g. CM_PAGES path via cmWorkspacePath or CM_PROTECTED_ROUTE from CM_PAGES, and CM_ROUTE_BASE from CM_FLAVOR.rootRoute.
zh.ts:2137 '交付物先经独立评审员审核' still uses 审核 for the reviewer's action, while the error strings now use 评审. Align it to 评审 in the next zh pass.

Cross-scope for the codemart lead to route: the server-side poly_apps/laravel_main/lang/zh_CN/codemart.php still has 审核员 x6 and 您 x20. It is outside codemart-ui scope; send it to the lang/ owner through the claude lead.
The report and cross_scope say the lead's icon set has 29 icons. assets/icons/ holds 28. Cosmetic.

d9-01-ui (next codemart-ui item): add the '?no-inline' query to the ICON_MODULES glob (cmImageRegistry.ts:2). Every icon is at most 1460 B, which is under Vite's 4096 B inline limit (lead-G1 note 3). Fill CM_ICON_SPECS at 128x128.

Local demo wallet rows all have a null description_code, so the coded ledger path is not exercised by local data. The G3 end-to-end calibration re-seeds or creates one coded row and checks the wallet.ledger text in en and zh.

DEFAULT_CURRENCY 'CNY' is repeated in CmArchitectPage:17, CmMarketplacePage:17, CmProjectsPage:21, CmTasksPage:24 and CmVerificationPage:28 (the member reported it). It belongs to cmdesign-03: one shared constant, or bootstrap policy.currency only.
